Azam Khan faces ED probe; Akhilesh Yadav criticizes BJP

Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan is under investigation by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya has raised questions, naming Akhilesh Yadav in connection with the probe. Akhilesh Yadav, in turn, stated that one cannot expect justice from the BJP, referring to the ED's action against Azam Khan.
